properties.name: A claim reads `gone` only when the server holding its session saw that session end; every other reader reports it unverifiable
properties.source: Anthony, 2026-09-29, in the dev_reflow2 hub session: "Let's go with your 3 likeliest candidates". Option (b) of dec:idea-a-claim-says-what-its-session-is-doing-and-never-reads-gone-when-it-cannot-be-verified, the liveness rule borrowed from orca's review ("no asserting what you cannot observe").
properties.statement: Only the server that holds a claiming session may report the claim as `gone`, and only once it has observed that session end. Every other reader reports the claim as unverifiable (`unknown`), never as `gone`, whether that reader is another server, a restarted server, or a hosted design. `gone` tells a colleague the ground is free. This sharpens req:claims-have-owners, which asks that a claim with no live owner be reported stale, by saying who may conclude that. It is the fix for fact:two-active-sessions-claims-both-read-gone-2026-09-22.
